facts.fact: Portaria 33/2026 of the Ministry of Justice sets fees for incorporating, amending and dissolving companies electronically through the single Plataforma Empresa Online, payable only online, in force on the platform's public availability.

The Plataforma Empresa Online (PEO), of the Cabo Verde government, offers company creation online as one package, including formalisation with the Commercial Registry (DGRNI), plus changes to company data and requests for dissolution.
The PEO company-creation package covers commercial registry formalisation, obtaining the Tax Identification Number (NIF) from DNRE and enrolment with social security (INPS) in one process.

note: A beneficial-owner list and platform are only planned under a bill passed in principle; no business register stated.

facts.fact: Lusa reports the government opened a tender to design and build an internet portal covering the whole life cycle of a company, with a first phase due by the end of the year and links to INPS, IGT, INCV and Pro-Empresa.
